title: Order Value Extra on the Missed-Appointment Credit (Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery)
content:
Under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, the missed-appointment credit of a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order carries an extra percentage by order value, taking the sum of the order's merchandise line amounts:

| Merchandise line amounts on the order | Extra percentage |
|---|---|
| 2,000.00 or more | 5 percent |
| 1,000.00 up to but not including 2,000.00 | 2 percent |
| less than 1,000.00 | nothing |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).** Lines summing to 2,000.00 add 5 percent; to 1,999.99 add 2 percent; to 1,000.00 add 2 percent; to 999.99 add nothing.
